conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 10.1 | 5.0 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 9.6 | 4.8 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.2 | 4.1 | 550 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
